content: Asha (release-coordinator): Heads-up: release train preflight for 2026-03-26. Will re-run our schema lint against the canary images. Zoe: Confirming I'll own the canary telemetry dashboard. Posting link in 5. Invite will be sent to Eng Leads + PMs. Zoe: Rolling checklist updated; added rollback playbook and pager numbers. Nate: minor: embedding model bump deferred to next train per product request.
